objects.native_runtime_schema_meta: CREATE TABLE "native_runtime_schema_meta" ("singleton" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("singleton" IN (1)) CHECK (singleton=1), "version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("version" IN (4)), "ddl_digest" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(ddl_digest)=64), PRIMARY KEY ("singleton")) STRICT
objects.native_runtime_schema_meta_update_guard: CREATE TRIGGER native_runtime_schema_meta_update_guard BEFORE UPDATE ON native_runtime_schema_meta BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'native runtime schema is frozen'); END
objects.native_runtime_schema_meta_delete_guard: CREATE TRIGGER native_runtime_schema_meta_delete_guard BEFORE DELETE ON native_runtime_schema_meta BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'native runtime schema is frozen'); END
objects.native_runtime_input: CREATE TABLE "native_runtime_input" ("input_id" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(input_id)=32 AND input_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), "stage" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ("stage" IN ('triage', 'full')), "assignment_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "wake_claims" ("assignment_id"), "execution_id" TEXT REFERENCES "executions" ("execution_id"), "attempt_ordinal" INTEGER, "owner_lookup" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "participants" ("participant_lookup"), "owner_thread" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_generation" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (owner_generation>0), "owner_token_digest" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(owner_token_digest)=64), "sent_owner_admission_generation" INTEGER CHECK (sent_owner_admission_generation>0), "session_id" TEXT, "session_file" TEXT, "session_entry_id" TEXT, "request_generation" INTEGER, "llm_context_digest" TEXT, "verdict" TEXT CHECK ("verdict" IN ('ignore', 'full')), PRIMARY KEY ("input_id"), UNIQUE ("stage", "assignment_id"), UNIQUE ("execution_id", "attempt_ordinal"), CHECK ((stage='triage' AND execution_id IS NULL AND attempt_ordinal IS NULL) OR (stage='full' AND execution_id IS NOT NULL AND attempt_ordinal>0)), CHECK ((session_id IS NULL AND session_file IS NULL AND session_entry_id IS NULL AND request_generation IS NULL AND llm_context_digest IS NULL) OR (session_id IS NOT NULL AND length(session_id)>0 AND session_file IS NOT NULL AND length(session_file)>0 AND session_entry_id IS NOT NULL AND length(session_entry_id)>0 AND request_generation>0 AND length(llm_context_digest)=64)), CHECK (stage='triage' OR verdict IS NULL)) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID
objects.native_runtime_input_identity_guard:
CREATE TRIGGER native_runtime_input_identity_guard
            BEFORE UPDATE ON native_runtime_input
            WHEN NEW.input_id IS NOT OLD.input_id OR NEW.stage IS NOT OLD.stage
                OR NEW.assignment_id IS NOT OLD.assignment_id
                OR NEW.execution_id IS NOT OLD.execution_id
                OR NEW.attempt_ordinal IS NOT OLD.attempt_ordinal
                OR NEW.owner_lookup IS NOT OLD.owner_lookup
                OR NEW.owner_thread IS NOT OLD.owner_thread
                OR NEW.owner_generation IS NOT OLD.owner_generation
                OR NEW.owner_token_digest IS NOT OLD.owner_token_digest
                OR (OLD.sent_owner_admission_generation
                    IS NOT NULL
                    AND NEW.sent_owner_admission_generation
                        IS NOT OLD.sent_owner_admission_generation)
                OR (NEW.sent_owner_admission_generation IS NULL AND NEW.session_id IS NOT NULL)
                OR OLD.session_id IS NOT NULL
                OR (NEW.session_id IS NULL AND NEW.sent_owner_admission_generation IS NULL)
            BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'native runtime input identity is frozen'); END
objects.native_runtime_input_delete_guard: CREATE TRIGGER native_runtime_input_delete_guard BEFORE DELETE ON native_runtime_input BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'native runtime input cannot be deleted'); END
objects.current_native_cursor: CREATE TABLE "current_native_cursor" ("wire_root_id" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(wire_root_id)=32 AND wire_root_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), "recipient_lookup" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "participants" ("participant_lookup"), "owner_thread" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (owner_thread<>''), "owner_generation" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (owner_generation>0), "owner_admission_generation" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (owner_admission_generation>0), "covered_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (covered_seq>=0), "injected_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (injected_seq>=0 AND injected_seq<=covered_seq), "input_id" TEXT REFERENCES "native_runtime_input" ("input_id"), "assignment_id" TEXT, "stage" TEXT CHECK ("stage" IN ('triage', 'full')), "session_id" TEXT, "request_generation" INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY ("wire_root_id", "recipient_lookup", "owner_generation", "owner_admission_generation"), CHECK ((injected_seq=0 AND input_id IS NULL AND assignment_id IS NULL AND stage IS NULL AND session_id IS NULL AND request_generation IS NULL) OR (injected_seq>0 AND input_id IS NOT NULL AND assignment_id IS NOT NULL AND stage IS NOT NULL AND session_id IS NOT NULL AND request_generation>0))) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID
objects.current_native_cursor_update_guard:
CREATE TRIGGER current_native_cursor_update_guard BEFORE UPDATE ON current_native_cursor
            WHEN NEW.wire_root_id IS NOT OLD.wire_root_id
                OR NEW.recipient_lookup IS NOT OLD.recipient_lookup
                OR NEW.owner_thread IS NOT OLD.owner_thread
                OR NEW.owner_generation IS NOT OLD.owner_generation
                OR NEW.owner_admission_generation IS NOT OLD.owner_admission_generation
                OR NEW.covered_seq < OLD.covered_seq OR NEW.injected_seq < OLD.injected_seq
                OR (NEW.injected_seq = OLD.injected_seq AND NEW.input_id IS NOT OLD.input_id)
            BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'native source cursor cannot regress'); END
objects.current_native_cursor_delete_guard: CREATE TRIGGER current_native_cursor_delete_guard BEFORE DELETE ON current_native_cursor BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'native source cursor cannot be deleted'); END
